plan: [In a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values, truthful bidding is a dominant strategy. No prior rounds to update beliefs, and values are redrawn each round, so bidding my true value maximizes expected long-run profit. Ties are random but do not change the dominant strategy. Therefore I will bid my private value of $39. ]

[This is a second-price sealed-bid auction (Vickrey). Truthful bidding (bid = my private value) is a dominant strategy: winning pays the second-highest bid, so bidding my value ($34) maximizes expected profit and avoids the risk of paying more than the item's worth. Use a bid of 34 (compliant with $0.1 increments).]

[In a sealed-bid second-price auction, truth-telling is a dominant strategy: bid your true private value to maximize expected profit. Bidding my value $45 ensures I win exactly when the second-highest bid is below 45, and I then pay that bid, yielding nonnegative profit when I win. Use a bid of 45.0 (allowed in $0.1 increments).]
